versions.content: Support of UDS service 0x2F InputOutputControlByIDentifier Description: The Diagnostic Management shall support the ISO 14229-1 service 0x2F InputOutputControlByIDentifier Rationale: Allow to simulate input values and to control output values AppliesTo: CP, AP Use Case: In workshop or production checks with the input and output channels of the ECU is needed. Supporting Material: ISO 14229-1
